description: This file is a PHP source code defining the Smarty_Internal_Extension_Handler class, responsible for dynamically loading and managing extensions within the Smarty templating engine runtime.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Extension_Handler
classes.description: This class manages dynamic loading and invocation of extensions, filters, and methods within Smarty, serving as a handler for extension operations in Smarty's internal runtime.

methods.name: _callExternalMethod
methods.description: Invokes an external method or property associated with Smarty extensions, handling dynamic method resolution based on naming conventions and internal state.

methods.name: upperCase
methods.description: Converts underscore-separated name parts into PascalCase format.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes extension objects based on property name, supporting dynamic extension loading.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a property value on the extension handler object.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles calls to undefined methods, delegating to a generic undefined method handler.
